faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from Starlite Festival?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is about 6 km (10 minutes by taxi) from Starlite's auditorium in Nagüeles. Most pre-concert cruises depart between 17:00 and 18:00, giving you time to sail, enjoy the sunset, and still reach the venue by 20:00.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food or drinks on board?
faq.a: Our charters already include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. You are welcome to bring additional food or drinks, but we recommend keeping it simple to enjoy the service. Glass bottles are allowed, but please be mindful of the boat's cleanliness.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for Starlite charters?
faq.a: We require 48 hours' notice for a full refund. Cancellations within 48 hours are non-refundable unless we can rebook the slot. Extreme weather may force cancellation; in that case, you get a full refund or rebooking option.

faq.q: Can I book a boat for just 2 hours before the concert?
faq.a: Yes, our 2-hour sunset charter (€749 for up to 9 guests on Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39) is perfect for a quick pre-concert cruise. You'll return to Puerto Banús by 19:30, leaving plenty of time to reach Starlite by 20:00.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a group of 10–12?
faq.a: For 10–12 guests, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) at €4,719 for 4 hours includes a free jet ski. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) and Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) are also excellent options. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Are children allowed on the boats?
faq.a: Yes, children are welcome on all our boats. Life jackets are provided for all sizes. Please note that the maximum passenger count includes children. For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are ideal family options.

faq.q: Do I need to book the boat and Starlite tickets separately?
faq.a: Yes, boat rental and concert tickets are separate bookings. We can help you coordinate the timing. Most guests book a 2-hour cruise (17:00–19:00) then head to Starlite. We recommend booking both at least 2 weeks in advance during peak season.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on the day?
faq.a: We monitor forecasts closely. If the captain determines it's unsafe to sail, we'll offer a full refund or reschedule. In case of light rain or moderate wind, the charter usually goes ahead as planned, as our boats have covered decks and cabins.

data.body_html:
Starlite Festival 2035 is coming to Marbella, and there's no better way to start the evening than with a pre-concert cruise from Puerto Banús. A marbella boat rental starlite festival 2035 combo lets you soak up the Costa del Sol sunset, sip cava, and arrive at the Nagüeles auditorium relaxed and ready. Our fleet of private charters includes everything from a 2-hour sunset trip for €749 to a 4-hour luxury cruise with a jet ski. All depart from Puerto Banús, just 10 minutes from Starlite.

Why a Pre-Concert Cruise Works for Starlite 2035

Starlite concerts typically start around 21:00, with gates opening at 20:00. A 2-hour cruise from 17:00 to 19:00 gives you time to enjoy the Marbella coastline, watch the sun dip behind La Concha, and still make it to the venue by 20:00. You avoid the rush-hour traffic from Marbella town, and you arrive with that holiday mindset already switched on.

The Mediterranean in July and August averages 28°C water temperature and 30°C air temperature, so evening cruises are perfect. You'll see the golden hour light on the Sierra Blanca mountains, and if you're lucky, dolphins near Cabopino.

Our Best Boats for Starlite Guests

We have 17 boats in our fleet, all based at Puerto Banús. For a pre-concert cruise, here are the top picks:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Ideal for a couple or small group.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – same pricing as Astondoa 40. Spacious flybridge for sunset views.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – from €4,719 for 4 hours, includes a free jet ski. Perfect for a party atmosphere.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – pricing on request. Great for a larger group wanting comfort.
  • Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax) – pricing on request. Sporty and stylish.

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras.

Typical Pre-Concert Itinerary

Here's a sample 2-hour cruise timeline:

  • 16:45 – Meet at Puerto Banús, next to the yacht club.
  • 17:00 – Depart. Head west towards Cabopino or east towards Marbella Marina.
  • 17:30 – Anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim (if time allows).
  • 18:00 – Cava and snacks served as the sun begins to set.
  • 18:45 – Return to Puerto Banús.
  • 19:00 – Disembark. Taxi to Starlite (€15–20, 10 minutes).

For a 4-hour charter, you can extend the swim stop, cruise towards Estepona, or include a jet ski session on the Mangusta 80.

What's Included in Every Charter

We don't do hidden costs. Every booking includes:

  • Licensed, English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts, sometimes fresh fruit)
  • Insurance and safety equipment (life jackets, first aid)
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – already in the price

You can bring your own food or extra drinks. The skipper will help you plan the route based on weather and your preferences.

Booking Tips for Starlite 2035

Starlite 2035 runs from early July to late August, with major headliners performing on weekends. Boat availability is tight during this period, especially for the 2-hour sunset slots. We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks in advance.

For groups of 10–12, the Mangusta 80 at €4,719 for 4 hours is the most popular option because it includes a jet ski. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 at €749 for 2 hours is unbeatable value.

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús. The marina is 6 km from Starlite's Nagüeles venue – a 10-minute taxi ride. There's also a bus service from Puerto Banús to Marbella town, but a taxi is easier with concert bags.

Other Ways to Combine Boat Rental with Starlite

If you're staying on the Golden Mile or in Marbella town, you can also charter a boat for a full day and then head to the concert. Our 8-hour charters (from €2,299) let you cruise to Sotogrande or even Gibraltar, with lunch at a chiringuito, then return to Puerto Banús by 18:00.

For a more intimate evening, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are great for couples. Pricing is on request – contact us via WhatsApp for a quick quote.

Check our full fleet on the Marbella boat rental page to see all options.
